_about: Public-domain Thomas Starr King (1824-1864), Unitarian minister in Boston and San Francisco, for the Word Hoard: The White Hills (1860), Patriotism and Other Papers (1864), Christianity and Humanity, a series of sermons (1877) and Substance and Show, and other lectures (1877; 1879 printing). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 64 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

starrking-white-hills: The White Hills (Boston, Crosby Nichols and company, 1860)
starrking-patriotism: Patriotism, and other papers. With a biographical sketch by Hon. Richard Frothingham (Tompkins, 1864)
starrking-christianity-humanity: Christianity and humanity (Boston, J.R. Osgood and company, 1877)
starrking-substance-and-show: Substance and show : and other lectures (Boston : Houghton, Osgood and company, 1879)

_excluded.starrking-other: The New Discussion of the Trinity (1860, by several hands); Christian pamphlet volumes
